newsitem.title: UK: European oil swaps steady to slightly firmer.
newsitem.headline: European oil swaps steady to slightly firmer.

text.p: European oil swaps were broadly steady to a touch stronger on Monday. This week's Brent CFDs slipped narrowly while fuel and gasoline ticked upwards and naphtha was flat.

Brent CFDs were marginally easier by a couple of cents with June 30-July 4, dipping to -28 cents against Brent from -26 cents on Friday. Later contracts were unchanged with July 7-11 at -27/28 cents against August, July 14-18 steady at -28 cents and July 21-25 hovering around -28 cents.
Gas oil spread cracks eased back by a couple of cents with Q4 at around $4.40, Q1 98 at $4.55-4.60 and Q2 98 unchanged at $4.10.
Heavy fuel tracked up a $1 or so with July pegged at $83.50/84.00. Wet activity was fairly quiet, but $85 was done earlier and $84.50 later.
Gasoline swaps gained $1.50 or so and the backwardation continued. July was put at $185.00, August at $184.00 and September $183.00.
Naphtha was steady with July at $173.50 and August and September retaining $1 and $3 contangos.
